synopsis: Mark Stuart had realized something terrifying: he had been reincarnated as the mid-boss in a game! synopsis: Kazuki Ishii has his life turned upside down — and is driven to suicide — after getting caught up in the romantic entanglements of his friend Teruhito Amada, who is wildly popular with the opposite sex, like the hero of a romantic comedy. However, a miracle occurs, and time is rewound back to the morning of his high school entrance ceremony. In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Nal Meongneun Geon Geumjiyang!
titleNative: 날 먹는 건 금지양!
synonyms: オオカミ男子は幼なじみを食べたい
synopsis: Nam Hae-Sul, who is handsome but famous for his dog-like personality, is only nice to his childhood friend, Yang Mi-Ru. "It's clear that he's nice to me because he likes me!" But is it really like that? Mi-Ru has no idea about Hae-Sul’s true feelings. Then one day, she finds out about the "black heart" that he harbors! Cracks are starting to appear in their 10-year friendship...! The wild growth story of a wolf boy and an innocent girl! (Source: Naver, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.
